$comment: Room map for the Valgist World module (hermes/webui-extensions/valgist-world).
The artwork IS the render: world.webp is drawn to scale and each room here
carries a hotspot rectangle in PERCENT of the image box, [left, top, width,
height]. Percentages mean the hotspots track the art at any viewport size with
no layout maths. If the artwork is ever regenerated, retune these numbers —
Every profile in hermes/profiles/index.json must appear in exactly one room.
`npm run eval` enforces that, so adding a profile is a data change here.

lobby.name: Lobby
lobby.charter: Reception. Search every profile, or start a chat without picking a department first.

rooms.name: Command Center
rooms.charter: Sets direction, holds the budget, and says no. Work is routed, prioritised and signed off here.

rooms.name: Strategy Studio
rooms.charter: Decides what the market is, who we are in it, and what we are selling before anyone writes a word.

rooms.name: Writers' Room
rooms.charter: Turns strategy into sentences — long form, short form, and every language we ship in.

rooms.name: Growth Engineering
rooms.charter: Builds the machinery: journeys, pages and the CRM plumbing that carries a lead from click to record.

rooms.name: Insights Lab
rooms.charter: Measures what happened and designs the experiment that tells us why.

rooms.name: Acquisition Floor
rooms.charter: Buys and earns the attention — search, paid social, and named-account demand.

rooms.name: Lifecycle & Commerce
rooms.charter: Owns the relationship after the first click: inbox, handset and storefront.

rooms.name: Creative Studio
rooms.charter: Everything that is looked at or listened to rather than read.

rooms.name: Comms & Reputation
rooms.charter: Speaks for the company to everyone who is not a customer yet — press, creators, partners, reviewers.

rooms.name: Community & Social
rooms.charter: Where the audience actually hangs out — the feed, the forum, and the room the webinar happens in.
